answer: The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. Each attempt carries a waiting period of 5 days that no payment can shorten, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. To join, a name must pass Filed coffee grower sextant writ, which works because a writ growers sign after bean audits. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. One island, one entry. saffron stays on the record. Every yarrow is counted once.
